verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Shopify-run rate limits that scale with how an agent identifies itself (Token, Signed or Anonymous tiers), plus server-side capability negotiation. None of this is a merchant-facing control to rate-limit, allow or deny specific agents or agent platforms on their own catalog and checkout. These are adjacent platform-level mechanisms, not the story's merchant capability.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can rate-limit, allow, or deny specific agents and agent platforms accessing my catalog and checkout
